methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - news.vcu.edu
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional peer-to-peer AI education infrastructure in Richmond, potentially creating a replicable model for distributed deep learning beyond traditional tech hubs if successfully scaled to community level.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools adopting ChatGPT under division oversight represents shallow-but-widespread platform adoption—students gain AI access without necessarily building deep technical capabilities, signaling potential for distributed surface-level fluency.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - Yahoo
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk deploying AI dispatchers for non-emergency calls demonstrates government procurement of sophisticated AI tools concentrated in larger municipal centers with budget capacity, while smaller jurisdictions lack resources to implement similar automation.

signals.title: How one Virginia county’s AI platform protects sensitive data - Route Fifty
signals.signal_reading: A Virginia county implementing data-protective AI platforms suggests emerging distributed capability in local government, indicating that technical sophistication around AI governance and privacy may be spreading beyond metro areas to county-level administrators.

signals.title: AI Boom Drives Fight Over Electric Bills as D.C., Virginia and Maryland Clash Over Data Centers - The Washington Informer
signals.signal_reading: Regional electric bill conflicts over NoVA data centers highlight how AI infrastructure investment concentrates in existing tech corridors, creating infrastructure dependencies that further entrench the geographic concentration of AI economic benefits and technical talent.
